## Context

- Unhandled Python exceptions in handlers/dependencies map to a generic **500** JSON. There is no way to turn **`ValueError` → 400**, **`NotFound` → 404**, etc., without hand-written `try/except` in every handler.
- See [Feature gaps](https://github.com/QueryaHub/OxyRoute/blob/main/docs/feature.md#3-маршрутизация-и-композиция) (global exception handlers).

## Direction

- Introduce a small **`HTTPException`** (or similar) with `status_code` and optional `detail` / `headers`, caught in Rust dispatch (or a thin Python wrapper) before the generic 500 path.
- Optional: `register_exception_handler(exc_type, callable)` for custom mapping, executed with GIL and safe error bodies (no stack traces in production by default; respect `OXYROUTE_DEBUG`).

## Acceptance criteria

- Pytest: raising the framework exception returns the expected status and body shape.
- Document pattern in `docs/handlers.md`.

## Research

- FastAPI `HTTPException` + `exception_handler`; must stay compatible with RSGI response helpers.
